package answer

import (
	"context"
	"sort"

	"github.com/example/ms-student-service/internal/domain"
	"github.com/example/ms-student-service/internal/domain/repository"
)

// SandboxResolver resolves sandbox by user/task/answer tuple.
type SandboxResolver interface {
	FindByUserAndTask(ctx context.Context, userID, taskID, answerID string) (string, error)
}

// ResultTaskSummary contains lightweight task data for result lists.
type ResultTaskSummary struct {
	ID          string
	LessonID    string
	CourseID    string
	Title       string
	Description string
}

// ResultTaskDetails contains task data for one result page.
type ResultTaskDetails struct {
	ID          string
	LessonID    string
	CourseID    string
	Title       string
	Description string
	MaxAttempts *int
}

// StudentResultItem represents one item in student result list.
type StudentResultItem struct {
	Answer    domain.StudentTaskAnswer
	SandboxID string
	Task      *ResultTaskSummary
}

// StudentResultsPage represents paginated student results.
type StudentResultsPage struct {
	Items  []StudentResultItem
	Limit  int
	Offset int
	Total  int
}

// ListStudentResultsInput controls result list pagination/filtering.
type ListStudentResultsInput struct {
	TaskID string
	Limit  int
	Offset int
}

// ListStudentResults loads attempts across all tasks for one user.
type ListStudentResults struct {
	Answers         repository.StudentTaskAnswerRepository
	TaskProvider    TaskProvider
	SandboxResolver SandboxResolver
}

// Handle returns paginated result list for the given student.
func (uc ListStudentResults) Handle(ctx context.Context, userID string, input ListStudentResultsInput) (*StudentResultsPage, error) {
	limit := input.Limit
	offset := input.Offset
	if limit <= 0 {
		limit = 20
	}
	if limit > 200 {
		limit = 200
	}
	if offset < 0 {
		offset = 0
	}

	var (
		answers []domain.StudentTaskAnswer
		total   int
		err     error
	)
	if input.TaskID != "" {
		answers, err = uc.Answers.ListForTaskAndStudent(ctx, input.TaskID, userID)
		if err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
		sort.Slice(answers, func(i, j int) bool {
			return answers[i].CreatedAt.After(answers[j].CreatedAt)
		})
		total = len(answers)
		start := offset
		if start > total {
			start = total
		}
		end := start + limit
		if end > total {
			end = total
		}
		answers = answers[start:end]
	} else {
		answers, err = uc.Answers.ListForStudent(ctx, userID, limit, offset)
		if err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
		total, err = uc.Answers.CountForStudent(ctx, userID)
		if err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
	}

	taskMeta := map[string]*ResultTaskSummary{}
	for _, item := range answers {
		if uc.TaskProvider == nil && item.LearningPathItemID == "" {
			continue
		}
		if _, exists := taskMeta[item.ID]; exists {
			continue
		}
		meta, metaErr := taskForAnswer(ctx, uc.TaskProvider, &item)
		if metaErr == nil && meta != nil {
			taskMeta[item.ID] = &ResultTaskSummary{
				ID:          meta.ID,
				LessonID:    meta.LessonID,
				CourseID:    meta.CourseID,
				Title:       meta.Title,
				Description: meta.Description,
			}
		}
	}

	items := make([]StudentResultItem, 0, len(answers))
	for _, item := range answers {
		resultItem := StudentResultItem{Answer: item}
		if uc.SandboxResolver != nil {
			if sandboxID, sandboxErr := uc.SandboxResolver.FindByUserAndTask(ctx, userID, item.TaskID, item.ID); sandboxErr == nil {
				resultItem.SandboxID = sandboxID
			}
		}
		if taskItem, ok := taskMeta[item.ID]; ok {
			resultItem.Task = taskItem
		}
		items = append(items, resultItem)
	}

	return &StudentResultsPage{
		Items:  items,
		Limit:  limit,
		Offset: offset,
		Total:  total,
	}, nil
}

// StudentResult aggregates full answer result payload.
type StudentResult struct {
	Details         *AnswerDetails
	Task            *ResultTaskDetails
	AttemptsForTask int
	SandboxID       string
}

// GetStudentResult loads detailed result payload for one answer.
type GetStudentResult struct {
	GetAnswer       GetStudentAnswer
	Answers         repository.StudentTaskAnswerRepository
	TaskProvider    TaskProvider
	SandboxResolver SandboxResolver
}

// Handle returns one result payload for the given student and answer.
func (uc GetStudentResult) Handle(ctx context.Context, userID, answerID string) (*StudentResult, error) {
	details, err := uc.GetAnswer.Handle(ctx, answerID)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	if details.Answer.StudentID != userID {
		return nil, domain.ErrForbidden
	}

	result := &StudentResult{Details: details}

	if uc.Answers != nil {
		if attempts, countErr := uc.Answers.CountForTaskAndStudent(ctx, details.Answer.TaskID, userID); countErr == nil {
			result.AttemptsForTask = attempts
		}
	}

	if uc.TaskProvider != nil || details.Answer.LearningPathItemID != "" {
		if taskMeta, taskErr := taskForAnswer(ctx, uc.TaskProvider, &details.Answer); taskErr == nil && taskMeta != nil {
			result.Task = &ResultTaskDetails{
				ID:          taskMeta.ID,
				LessonID:    taskMeta.LessonID,
				CourseID:    taskMeta.CourseID,
				Title:       taskMeta.Title,
				Description: taskMeta.Description,
				MaxAttempts: taskMeta.MaxAttempts,
			}
		}
	}

	if uc.SandboxResolver != nil {
		if sandboxID, sandboxErr := uc.SandboxResolver.FindByUserAndTask(ctx, userID, details.Answer.TaskID, details.Answer.ID); sandboxErr == nil {
			result.SandboxID = sandboxID
		}
	}

	return result, nil
}
